name: Parabolic SAR daily swing (aggressive AF 0.05/0.075/1.0)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: Uptrend (PSAR below candles) -> long via stop order at next-bar SAR (ParLE).
entry_short: Downtrend (PSAR above candles) -> short via stop at next-bar SAR.
exit: Exit when candle crosses the PSAR; reversal into short (ParSE) via stop at next-bar SAR.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: AF max 1.0 is unusually high (SAR collapses quickly); keep as written for faithful replication.
